# Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram

**Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram** (RKKP) is a public organization in Denmark responsible for national clinical quality development and monitoring. It is the authoritative body that administers, manages, and publishes the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] [^src1]. RKKP produces comprehensive annual reports evaluating the quality of care for patients with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src18], including the flagship [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] publication [^src28]. The organization's official web presence is [[www-rkkp-dk|www.rkkp.dk]] [^src1].

### Organizational Structure and Stakeholders
RKKP operates with a dedicated analytical unit, the [[rkkp-videncenter|RKKP's Videncenter]], which is responsible for preparing the analytical and epidemiological commentary found in the annual reports [^src23]. The organization oversees and collaborates closely with the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]], a steering committee that evaluates clinical indicators and considers methodological adjustments such as age-standardization [^src5], [^src13]. [[julie-andersen|Julie Andersen]] serves as a primary contact person and representative for the data-responsible authority within RKKP [^src15], [^src23]. To ensure the nationwide implementation of clinical guidelines, RKKP also collaborates with [[sig-af|SIG AF]] [^src35].

### Clinical Quality Indicators and Standards
A core function of RKKP is defining and measuring clinical quality indicators to benchmark healthcare performance across Danish regions and hospitals. The organization sets strict standards, such as the ≥80% target for echocardiography [^src21]. RKKP monitors a wide array of specific metrics, including [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] (TSH measurement at diagnosis) [^src27], [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]] and [[indikator-4a3|Indikator 4a3]] (anticoagulation treatment coverage over time) [^src29], [^src44], [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] (intracranial hemorrhage incidence) [^src44], [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]] (severe bleeding incidence) [^src44], and [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] (structured patient education) [^src44]. RKKP applies rigorous statistical interpretations to these metrics, utilizing 95% confidence intervals to determine whether a department's performance deviates significantly from the national standard or if the variation is merely due to chance [^src45].

### System Limitations and Data Infrastructure
While RKKP drives quality improvement, its reports frequently highlight systemic barriers and data infrastructure limitations within the Danish healthcare system. For instance, RKKP identified a critical data collection issue where TSH tests embedded in local blood sample packages are missed by the national registry because they are recorded using local codes rather than the official NPU codes required by RKKP [^src49]. Consequently, it remains technically impossible for RKKP to secure accurate data capture for these specific codes [^src49]. Performance evaluations also reveal significant regional disparities; no regions met the standard for Indikator 3 [^src27], and regional variations were heavily noted for Indikator 8 [^src48] and severe bleeding rates [^src34].

### Timeline and Recent Developments
The reporting period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, marked a significant phase of expansion for the database [^src1]. Notably, starting June 1, 2023, RKKP successfully established data collection pipelines from private practicing cardiologists [^src47], and test data from general practice began flowing into the system [^src47]. RKKP continues to publish updated evaluations and methodology documents, including the forthcoming [[afdk-2025|AFDK 2025]] report [^src46].

## Claims
**quality-standard**
- Standarden for ekkokardiografi er ≥80% [^src1] [^src21]

**performance**
- Ingen regioner opfylder standarden for Indikator 3 [^src1] [^src27]
- Regionalt varierede andelen fra 24-43% og ingen regioner opfylder således standarden[^src1] [^src48]

**epidemiological**
- På regionsniveau varierede andelen som blev indlagt med alvorlig blødning mellem 1,9-2,2% [^src1] [^src34]

**quality-indicator-definition**
- Indikator 4a måler andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, med indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling, der modtager behandling (ud af den population hvor det er indiceret) [^src1] [^src44]
- For indikator 4a er tælleren patienter i nævneren, som modtager behandling, dvs. der er indløst mindst én recept i perioden 90 dage før til 90 dage efter 1, 2 og 5-års dagen for diagnosedatoen for atrieflimren [^src1] [^src44]
- Indikator 4b måler andelen af patienter med atrieflimren i behandling med direkte orale antikoagulantia (DOAC) med mindst 1 måling af P-creatinin årligt [^src1] [^src44]
- Indikator 5 måler incidens af iskæmisk apopleksi blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren [^src1] [^src44]
- Indikator 6 måler incidens af intrakraniel blødning blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren [^src1] [^src44]
- Indikator 7 måler incidens af alvorlig blødning (tillempede International Society of Thrombosis and Hemostasis (ISTH) kriterier) blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren [^src1] [^src44]
- Indikator 8 måler andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren som får et struktureret undervisningsprogram indenfor 1 år efter diagnosen er stillet [^src1] [^src44]

**statistical-interpretation**
- Såfremt de anførte 95% CI for indikatorværdien ikke omfatter standardværdien, kan det konkluderes, at afdelingen ligger enten over eller under den opstillede standard, og at forskellen i forhold til standarden ikke kan forklares ved tilfældig variation. Der foreligger med andre ord en statistisk signifikant forskel [^src1] [^src45]
- Omfaatter 95% CI derimod standardværdien, er det ikke muligt at afgøre om indikatorværdien med sikkerhed adskiller sig fra den opstillede standard [^src1] [^src45]

**methodological-definition**
- Tidligere år (95% CI): Angiver indikatorværdi i forrige opgørelsesperioder [^src1] [^src45]

**organizational-change**
- Der er nu etableret tilknytning af praktiserende speciallæger i kardiologi, der siden 1. juni 2023 har opsamlet data [^src1] [^src47]

**data-infrastructure**
- Der er begyndt at indløbe data fra almen praksis i test-version [^src1] [^src47]

**data-collection-issue**
- Auditering har vist, at TSH prøver der indgår i pakker ikke er med i den datafangst der laves fra RKKP, da TSH i ”pakken” afrapporteres på en lokal blodprøve kode og ikke den officielle NPU kode, som RKKP anvender til datafangst [^src1] [^src49]

**system-limitation**
- Det er fortsat ikke muligt for RKKP at sikre datafangst på disse koder [^src1] [^src49]

## Timeline
- 1. juli 2022 – 30. juni 2023: Rapporteret periode for årsrapporten fra Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark [^src1]
- 1. juni 2023: Start af dataopsamling fra praktiserende speciallæger i kardiologi [^src47]
